name: PostPin Newsletter Builder
author: Jorge del Campo Andrade

sections.description:
PostPin Newsletter Builder allows you to generate customized newsletters designed for physical printing (Mercurio format 77×110 cm) and digital email distribution (600px width responsive layout).

  • Choose your newsletter type (print or email).
  • Upload and set custom header and footer images.
  • Select up to 5 posts and completely customize their titles and excerpts.
  • Live preview your newsletter before exporting.
  • Generate, download, and share your newsletter!

External Services

This plugin utilizes a third-party API to generate QR code images that are included in newsletters.

  • Service: QRServer API (by goqr.me)
  • Purpose: To generate and display QR codes for post URL scanning.
  • Data sent: An encoded URL containing the post URL. No personal data (such as names or emails) is sent to this service.
  • Links: Privacy Policy / API Documentation.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/.
  2. Activate the plugin from the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
sections.faq:
How many posts can I include?

You can add up to 5 posts to your newsletter.

Can I include other post types besides regular posts?

The plugin only supports standard WordPress posts.

Can I edit the post content specifically for the newsletter?

Yes, you can fully customize the title and excerpt within the newsletter builder. These changes will only affect the newsletter layout, leaving your original WordPress posts intact.

Can I switch the template type once the newsletter has been created?

Yes, you can easily switch between print and email layouts at any time. Make sure to preview your changes to confirm everything looks correct.

Does this plugin include an email delivery system?

No, this plugin focuses on generating the clean HTML content for your email template or a PDF for print. You can copy the generated HTML and use your preferred email marketing platform to send it.

What output format is used for the print newsletter?

Print templates are exported directly into a high-quality PDF format.
